prompt: Write 5 short claim log entries by an auto insurance adjuster for a sideswipe while changing lanes claim. Injury: neck and back strain. The claimant is represented by a lawyer. Start each entry on a new line with 'Entry 1:', 'Entry 2:' and so on. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1354; do not mention it.)
text:
Entry 1: Received first notice of loss by phone from the insured driver. Reports a sideswipe while changing lanes on a multi-lane road. Insured states the other vehicle drifted into their lane. Police report requested. No obvious airbag deployment reported. Opened bodily injury and property damage exposures.

Entry 2: Spoke with the third-party driver. Driver disputes lane-change fault and says the insured moved over without signaling. Scene photos received from insured show scrape damage along the passenger side of the insured vehicle and the driver side of the other vehicle. Liability currently unclear; reserving for shared fault pending police findings.

Entry 3: Claimant has retained counsel. Attorney letter of representation received and logged. All further contact with the claimant to go through counsel. Attorney requests medical authorization forms and a copy of the policy declarations page. Forms sent out today.

Entry 4: Claimant reports neck and back strain following the collision. Treating provider notes muscle spasm and reduced range of motion. Attorney submitted initial treatment records and is requesting a settlement demand package. Bodily injury reserve increased to reflect ongoing physical therapy. Scheduled a records review with the medical nurse consultant.

Entry 5: Police report received. Officer cited the other driver for failure to yield during a lane change, though the report notes both drivers gave conflicting accounts. Liability assessment updated to favor the insured at a moderate level. Attorney notified of the preliminary finding. File remains open pending receipt of complete medical bills and the demand package.
